description: This file contains implementations for HTTP authentication backend registration and management functions, including scheme and backend handling, initialization, free operations, and rule matching.

methods.name: const http_auth_scheme_t * http_auth_scheme_get(const buffer * name)
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication scheme matching the provided name.

methods.name: void http_auth_scheme_set(const http_auth_scheme_t * scheme)
methods.description: Sets or adds an authentication scheme to the scheme list.

methods.name: const http_auth_backend_t * http_auth_backend_get(const buffer * name)
methods.description: Retrieves the backend matching the provided name.

methods.name: void http_auth_backend_set(const http_auth_backend_t * backend)
methods.description: Sets or adds an authentication backend to the backend list.

methods.name: void http_auth_dumbdata_reset(void)
methods.description: Resets all authentication schemes and backends to empty state.

methods.name: http_auth_require_t * http_auth_require_init(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new http_auth_require_t structure.

methods.name: void http_auth_require_free(http_auth_require_t * const require)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with an http_auth_require_t structure.

methods.name: int http_auth_match_rules(const http_auth_require_t * const require,const char * const user,const char * const group,const char * const host)
methods.description: Checks if user, group, or host matches the require rules.

methods.name: void http_auth_setenv(request_st * const r,const char * username,size_t ulen,const char * auth_type,size_t alen)
methods.description: Sets environment variables for remote user and auth type.

methods.name: unsigned int http_auth_digest_len(int algo)
methods.description: Returns length of the digest for the specified algorithm.
